genotype_to_drug_rule: Fits deterministic column-wise LightGBM 4.6.0 (400 rounds max, lr=0.1, max_depth=4, num_leaves=16, min_data_in_leaf=1, lambda_l2=1.0, min_sum_hessian_in_leaf=1.0, feature_fraction=0.5, patience=25 on outer fold 15% holdout, balanced fitting-side weights) on outer training fold's 4,000 screened features; calls R at score >= 0.5.

i_handling.description: LightGBM outputs continuous probabilities thresholded at 0.5 (>=0.5 -> R, <0.5 -> S); any uncalled or failed fold genome is counted separately and never mapped to S.
